notes.sowing: Sow {cm:0.6} deep as soon as the soil can be worked; seed sprouts in cold soil from about {c:4}. Sow small batches every 2 weeks, but skip spring sowings that would mature in summer heat. Resume in late summer until about 4 weeks before your first fall frost.
notes.care: Heat, long days and dry soil make arugula bolt and turn very hot. Keep it watered, thin crowded rows, and give light shade in warm spells.
notes.harvest: Start picking about 4 weeks after sowing. Cut leaves {cm:2.5} to {cm:5} above the crown so the plant regrows, and pull plants once they flower.
